reuse_policy.step1: Search for direct 2021 evidence first for each repeat person.
reuse_policy.step2: If no direct 2021 evidence is available, the already frozen 2020 target2020 observation is admissible as nearest_within_window evidence because it lies inside 2020-01-01 through 2022-12-31.
reuse_policy.step3: A 2022 direct observation may supersede a 2020 nearest candidate only when no direct 2021 evidence is available and it is the closer/better-supported window observation under the protocol.
reuse_policy.step4: Never import a lifetime post-selection peak outside the T+10 window.

special_cases.name: 박원순
special_cases.reason: Death occurred before the 2021 target year and prevents meaningful 2021 role-occupancy assessment. A 2020 role observation may be retained descriptively but must not be treated as an ordinary 2021 failure or ordinary assessable snapshot.

special_cases.name: 이주호
special_cases.reason: Official 2022 appointment lies inside the admissible T+10 window. Check for direct 2021 evidence first; if absent, 2022 is an admissible nearest-within-window observation.

guardrails: Existing 2020 evidence gives all 38 repeat persons an admissible evidence path, but does not automatically finalize their T+10 score because 2021 direct evidence has priority.
Repeat status does not create an independent person in pooled person-level analyses.

The 2010 target2020 observation and the 2011 T+10 observation are distinct research snapshots even when the same 2020 evidence is reused; provenance must record reuse rather than duplicate the underlying evidence claim.
Death before the target year is a competing event, not a zero score or ordinary failure.
